title: papaver paniculatum subsp. pseudoregium
intro: Papaver paniculatum subsp. pseudoregium, commonly known as Himalayan Poppy or Meconopsis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of Papaver paniculatum subsp. pseudoregium include its antioxidant and anti-anxiety properties, which can help alleviate stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
